info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, loopX, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  this.locZ = 103endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos  end ifend
info.name: Submarine
